design: Original/new-wording discovery means crossed3x3 with exact component controls. Four discovery items only; same96 heldout items. Copy-to-task block9 state and attention10-17 output changes, four items per family/form. Evaluate96 second-wording transfer copy prompts. Native/predicted/exact3x3 component factorial; other-task pair control and live-additive attention variant. Predicted attention replaces writes with cached receiver-native attention plus discovery mean, while native mode recomputes live. No MLP edits; full strength fixed.
limitations: Predictions require receiver native baseline, known family/form and full network. Exact controls use donor states. Retrospective panel, no output fitting. Fixed write prediction differs from live additive feedback.
design_clarification: Executed original-wording/new-wording/exact boundary x original-wording/new-wording/exact attention (9 conditions), plus native/native, native/exact, exact/native (3 reference conditions). No other-task or live-additive condition was rerun in H660; those phrases in inherited design text refer to H659.
